About this Event

About the PartyBLOCKBUSTER BOLLYWOOD is back—and this time, it’s bigger, bolder, and built for the dance floor! High On Bolly brings you the hottest party experience at the incredible Era Lounge, where Bollywood nostalgia collides with explosive EDM vibes.
Fall in love with music all over again as we journey from timeless Sonu Nigam and Arijit Singh melodies to viral hits from Diljit Dosanjh, Karan Aujla, Honey Singh, Badshah, Agsy, and today’s EDM biggest club bangers.
Feel the thrill of a full-scale EDM vibes without leaving the san jose —electric visuals, craft cocktails, and high-energy Go-Go dance performances. Whether you live for nostalgic sing-alongs or bass-heavy club edits, this night is your vibe.
Bring your crew and own the dance floor again!

What to Expect• Bollywood EDM + high-energy DJ sets
• Mesmerizing Go Go dance performances
• Tulum-inspired handcrafted cocktails
• Immersive lighting, visuals & tropical ambiance
• A stylish, upscale crowd and unforgettable nightlife energy
